```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, out.width="100%"}
# ======================================================
# SES histogram + clustered categorical guild heatmap
# Pollinator + plant species counts in labels
# ======================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

alpha <- 0.05
critical_value <- qnorm(0.975)
top_n_plants <- 18

# Transparency of the shaded regions in panel A
region_alpha <- 0.07

cat_levels <- c(
  "Avoidance",
  "No difference",
  "Preference"
)

cat_labels <- c(
  "Avoidance",
  "No difference",
  "Preference"
)

plot_cols <- c(
  "Avoidance" = "#F1A340",
  "No difference" = "grey85",
  "Preference" = "#7B3294"
)

guild_order <- c(
  "Apidae",
  "Andrenidae",
  "Halictidae",
  "Megachilidae",
  "Colletidae",
  "Melittidae",
  "Non-bee Hymenoptera",
  "Bombylids",
  "Syrphids",
  "Other Diptera",
  "Lepidoptera",
  "Coleoptera",
  "Other taxa"
)

# ======================================================
# Load data
# ======================================================

SES_guild <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/SES_guild_split_bees.rds"
)

pval_df_guild <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/pval_df_guild_split_bees.rds"
)

raw_data <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/interaction_data.rds"
)

# ======================================================
# Count pollinator species per guild
# ======================================================

poll_order <- c(
  "Hymenoptera",
  "Diptera",
  "Coleoptera",
  "Lepidoptera"
)

bee_families <- c(
  "Apidae",
  "Andrenidae",
  "Halictidae",
  "Megachilidae",
  "Colletidae",
  "Melittidae"
)

guild_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pollinator_accepted_name),
    Pollinator_rank == "SPECIES",
    Pollinator_order %in% poll_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollinator_guild = case_when(
      Pollinator_order == "Hymenoptera" &
        Pollinator_family %in% bee_families ~ Pollinator_family,

      Pollinator_order == "Hymenoptera" ~
        "Non-bee Hymenoptera",

      Pollinator_family == "Bombyliidae" ~
        "Bombylids",

      Pollinator_family == "Syrphidae" ~
        "Syrphids",

      Pollinator_order == "Diptera" ~
        "Other Diptera",

      Pollinator_order == "Lepidoptera" ~
        "Lepidoptera",

      Pollinator_order == "Coleoptera" ~
        "Coleoptera",

      TRUE ~
        "Other taxa"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Pollinator_guild,
    Pollinator_accepted_name
  ) %>%
  count(
    Pollinator_guild,
    name = "n_species"
  )

# ======================================================
# Count plant species per family
# ======================================================

plant_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Plant_accepted_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Plant_family,
    Plant_accepted_name
  ) %>%
  count(
    Plant_family,
    name = "n_species"
  )

# ======================================================
# A) SES histogram
# ======================================================

SES_df <- as.data.frame(SES_guild) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_genus",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SES)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      SES < -critical_value ~ "Avoidance",
      SES > critical_value ~ "Preference",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = cat_levels
    )
  )

x_lim <- quantile(
  abs(SES_df$SES),
  0.85,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Ensure the critical-value lines remain inside the visible range
x_lim <- max(
  x_lim,
  critical_value
)

p_ses <- ggplot(
  SES_df,
  aes(
    x = SES,
    fill = category
  )
) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------
  # Shaded avoidance region
  # ----------------------------------------------------
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -x_lim,
    xmax = -critical_value,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = unname(plot_cols["Avoidance"]),
    alpha = region_alpha
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------
  # Shaded preference region
  # ----------------------------------------------------
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = critical_value,
    xmax = x_lim,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = unname(plot_cols["Preference"]),
    alpha = region_alpha
  ) +

  # Histogram remains unchanged and is drawn above shading
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 1100,
    alpha = 0.9,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    position = "identity"
  ) +

  ggtitle("a)") +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -critical_value,
      critical_value
    ),
    linetype = "longdash",
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "#3B3B3B"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Standardized effect size (SES)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 13
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      size = 1.5
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 13,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# B) Heatmap data
# ======================================================

heat_df <- as.data.frame(SES_guild) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_guild",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pval_df_guild,
    by = c(
      "Plant_family",
      "Pollinator_guild"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SES)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      p_two < alpha & SES > 0 ~ "Avoidance",
      p_two < alpha & SES < 0 ~ "Preference",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = cat_levels
    )
  )

plant_keep <- heat_df %>%
  group_by(
    Plant_family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    signal = sum(abs(SES)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    signal,
    n = top_n_plants
  ) %>%
  pull(
    Plant_family
  )

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  filter(
    Plant_family %in% plant_keep
  )

ses_mat <- heat_df %>%
  select(
    Plant_family,
    Pollinator_guild,
    SES
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Pollinator_guild,
    values_from = SES,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(
    "Plant_family"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

plant_order <- rownames(ses_mat)[
  hclust(
    dist(ses_mat)
  )$order
]

guild_labels <- guild_n_species %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      Pollinator_guild,
      " (",
      n_species,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Pollinator_guild,
    label
  ) %>%
  deframe()

plant_labels <- plant_n_species %>%
  filter(
    Plant_family %in% plant_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      Plant_family,
      " (",
      n_species,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Plant_family,
    label
  ) %>%
  deframe()

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    Plant_family = factor(
      Plant_family,
      levels = plant_order,
      labels = plant_labels[plant_order]
    ),

    Pollinator_guild = factor(
      Pollinator_guild,
      levels = rev(
        guild_order[
          guild_order %in% names(guild_labels)
        ]
      ),
      labels = rev(
        guild_labels[
          guild_order[
            guild_order %in% names(guild_labels)
          ]
        ]
      )
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# C) Heatmap
# ======================================================

p_heat <- ggplot(
  heat_df,
  aes(
    x = Plant_family,
    y = Pollinator_guild,
    fill = category
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    colour = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    name = "Observed against null"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Plant family",
    y = "Pollinator guild"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  ) +

  ggtitle("b)") +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      colour = "black"
    ),

    legend.box.background = element_rect(
      colour = "black"
    ),

    legend.margin = margin(
      4,
      20,
      4,
      8
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Combined plot
# ======================================================

p_ses <- p_ses +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      1,
      1,
      1,
      1
    )
  )

p_ses <- p_ses +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  )

p_heat <- p_heat +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",

    legend.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    legend.box.margin = margin(
      t = -5
    ),

    legend.margin = margin(
      2,
      2,
      2,
      2
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    )
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )

p_heat <- p_heat +

  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "right"
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Dummy legend plot
# ======================================================

legend_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(
    category = factor(
      cat_levels,
      levels = cat_levels
    )
  ),
  aes(
    x = category,
    fill = category
  )
) +

  geom_bar(
    alpha = 0
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    breaks = cat_levels,
    labels = cat_labels,
    name = "Observed against null",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = "white"
    ),

    legend.box.background = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.5
    ),

    legend.box.margin = margin(
      0,
      0,
      0,
      0
    ),

    legend.margin = margin(
      t = 4,
      r = 6,
      b = 6,
      l = 6
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      0,
      0,
      2,
      0
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Remove legends from main plots
# ======================================================

p_ses_noleg <- p_ses +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  )

p_heat_noleg <- p_heat +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  )

# ======================================================
# Horizontal plots
# ======================================================

plots_row <- plot_grid(
  p_ses_noleg,
  p_heat_noleg,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "h",
  axis = "tb",
  rel_widths = c(
    1,
    1.4
  )
)

plots_row <- plots_row +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = -20,
      l = 0
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Final figure with visible centered legend
# ======================================================

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  plots_row,
  legend_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(
    1,
    0.18
  )
)

combined_plot
```
